job.domain: an HR and finance helpdesk assistant

items.text:
Subject: Onboarding checklist for Priya Raman (starting 14 April)

Hi team, please find below the onboarding checklist we'll follow for Priya Raman, who joins the Research Finance team as a Grants Officer on 14 April. The payroll side is straightforward: HR admin will set up her record in the system by 9 April, and Finance will confirm her cost centre and approver group the day before she starts. I've asked IT to prepare her laptop and badge, and her line manager will walk her through the grant application workflow in her first week. Once the induction checklist is signed off, please email hr-helpdesk@northlea.ac.uk so we can close the ticket. Any changes to the schedule should go through me, not directly to IT.

intent.requested_action: follow and confirm the onboarding checklist and email the helpdesk when signed off

items.text:
Subject: Draft of the cost-recovery paper — comments welcome

Hi all, attached is the current draft of our paper on cost recovery in university research grants. The methods section still needs work, but I wanted to get the internal review moving before the submission window closes.

Could you each have a look at the sections relevant to you? Daniel, please check the figures in Table 3 against the ledger export; the system generated the totals automatically and I haven't yet reconciled them by hand. Sofia, the paragraph on overhead allocation needs a second opinion — I've left a note in the margins rather than rewriting it myself.

I should mention that I used an AI assistant to tidy up the abstract and suggest some phrasing, but all the analysis and conclusions are my own. If anyone objects to that, let me know and I'll rework it. Comments by Friday would be ideal.

Best,
Elena

intent.requested_action: review the paper draft and send comments by Friday

items.text:
Subject: Grant application — reviewer assignment

Hi Sanjay, the grant application from the Fitzroy partnership is now in the system and ready for reviewer assignment. Please note that the admin panel will only let you assign reviewers once the conflict-of-interest declarations are uploaded, so chase those first. Once that's done, the finance check can run in parallel with the scientific review. I've left the full instructions in the shared drive under Grants 2024. Let me know if the system throws an error when you save the assignments.

intent.requested_action: upload conflict declarations and assign reviewers

items.text:
Subject: Questions about the new expense chatbot

Hi there, I've been trying out the expense chatbot that Finance rolled out last month and I'm a bit confused about how it handles receipts. When I upload a photo, the automated tool seems to read the total but not the VAT line, so my claims keep getting bounced back. Could someone explain the correct process, or point me to the guidance page? I'd rather not keep resubmitting and bothering the admin team. Thanks, Rachel Okafor (Dept of Chemistry).

intent.requested_action: explain the correct receipt process or share guidance

items.text:
Subject: Grant application — final checks before submission

Dear colleagues, the deadline for the Alder Trust grant application is 30 May, and I'd like us to do a final round of checks before it goes in. The system closes submissions at 17:00 sharp, so there's no room for a late upload.

Please review the following: the budget justification (all figures must match the finance ledger), the letters of support (we still need one from the external partner), and the ethics statement. I've put the full checklist in the shared folder; the instructions there are the same ones we used for the Wellcome bid last year.

One more thing: the admin office has asked that we route any queries through the grants mailbox rather than individual emails, so they can keep a single record. That includes questions about the online form.

If you spot anything missing, flag it by Wednesday so we have time to fix it.

Many thanks,
Tom

intent.requested_action: review the application materials and flag missing items by Wednesday

items.text:
Subject: Notes from the finance systems review

Hello all, following last week's review of our finance systems, here's a short summary of what we agreed.

First, the admin team will take over management of the expense chatbot's settings; the automated tool has been misclassifying travel claims, and we want a human in the loop before changes go live. Second, the instructions for submitting grant applications will be updated to reflect the new cost codes, which come into force on 1 June. Third, the research paper that used the AI assistant for copy-editing has been cleared by the ethics office, so no further action is needed there.

Please circulate these notes to your teams. If anything looks wrong, let me know by the end of the week.

Best wishes,
Helen Marsh

intent.requested_action: circulate the review notes and report anything wrong by end of week
